conbody.p: The inattentive warning light () blinking and warning message will appear on the cluster and an audible warning will sound to suggest that the driver take a break, when the driver’s attention level is below a certain level.

li.p: Driver Attention Warning will not suggest a break when the total driving time is shorter than 4 minutes or 4 minutes has not passed after the last break was suggested.

conbody.p: The driver’s attention level is determined when the vehicle has met the following conditions:

li.p: The driver’s individual driving patterns such as steering, acceleration, and deceleration.
Driving conditions such as driving time.

conbody.p: Driver attention level is reset under the following conditions:

li.p: When the driver’s seat belt is unfastened and the door is opened and closed while stationary.
When the vehicle is stopped for more than 10 minutes.

conbody.p: To deactivate the inattentive driving warning function, please press the OK button.
Taking a break activates under the following condition:

li.p: Vehicle speed: approximately 60 km/h or higher

note.p: For your safety, change the Settings after parking the vehicle at a safe location.

li.p: Driver Attention Warning may suggest a break depending on the driver’s driving pattern or habits, even if the driver doesn't feel fatigue.
Driver Attention Warning is a supplemental function and may not be able to determine whether the driver is inattentive.
The driver who feels fatigued should take a break at a safe location, even though there is no break suggestion by Driver Attention Warning.
While the Forward Attention Warning is active, the Inattentive Driving Warning is limited.
